openwrt_wiki.Einleitung: series of miniature routers based on the MediaTek MT7620n with two Ethernet ports and a 802.11n 2T/2R 2.4 GHz 300Mbps wireless interface. There are several models with different hardware and software features.

Modelltabelle.Description: Wireless router with USB port and 3G dongle support¹
Wireless router with USB port and 3G dongle support¹
Wireless router with USB port, 3G dongle support and extra features¹²

Fussnoten.1: differences between WT3020H, WT3020F and WT3020AD are only found in the original firmware
Fussnoten.3: different hardware model, see below (auf der Seite nicht weiter ausgeführt)

Info.Flash chip: Winbond W25Q32BV (4MB), W25Q64BV or cFeon Q64-104HIP or 25Q64FVSIG (8MB) ¹

openwrt_wiki.Serial connection: The serial port of the WT3020 can be accessed using the TTL pins shown in the image below. A voltage level converter (such as a CP2102 TTL-USB dongle) is required. Foto wt3020a_serial_ttl.jpg (WT3020A). The communication settings are: 57600 bps 8N1.
openwrt_wiki.Identifying the device: On the WT3020H model (8 MB flash), the Ethernet MAC starts with 20:28:18:...
openwrt_wiki.GPIO: GPIOs 0, 2, 18, and 19 are exposed on the board (WT3020H), connected to pull-down resistors.
Known problems: certain versions of uboot are reported as problematic - POSSIBLE BRICK (dev.openwrt.org/ticket/19570)
factory firmware to do the initial upgrade is reported non-working, fails with "Bad Magic Number", sysupgrade via mtd works (ticket 19983)
failsafe mode is reported non-working (ticket 18768). The same issue again exists with the WT3020F "new" hardware model on CC.15.05rc3
openwrt_wiki.Failsafe: Update 03 jan 2018: Failsafe mode appears again to be broken, with the new hardware model. More details will follow.
openwrt_wiki.Installation (Flash firmware): factory.bin über Stock-Web-UI http://192.168.8.1 (admin/admin), System Setting -> Upgrade Firmware; danach LuCI auf 192.168.1.1
openwrt_wiki.Installation (Flash uboot): Seite beschreibt Ersatz des Bootloaders durch Breed (breed-mt7620-reset1.bin), getestet u. a. mit WT3020F (OpenWrt 18.06.1); Breed-Weboberfläche per Reset-Taste beim Einstecken des Micro-USB
openwrt_wiki.Flash layout: mtd0 u-boot 0x30000, mtd1 u-boot-env 0x10000, mtd2 factory 0x10000, mtd3 firmware 0x7b0000
openwrt_wiki.Factory: MAC-Adresse in mtd2 (factory) Offset 4; eth0.2 (WAN) = LAN-MAC + 1
openwrt_wiki.Netzwerk: WAN-Port (towards the edge of the PCB) ist eth0.2; Switch-Port 0 = WAN, LAN auf VLAN 1
openwrt_wiki.Bootlog (WT3020H): U-Boot 1.1.3 (Jan 3 2014), Ralink UBoot Version 4.1.1.0, ASIC 7620_MP, DRAM 512 Mbits DDR width 16, 64 MB, flash EN25Q64 (8 MB), CPU 580 MHz, console=ttyS0,57600, SoC Ralink MT7620N ver:2 eco:6
openwrt_wiki.PoE mod: Bastelanleitung: PoE über freie Adernpaare 4/5 und 7/8 (nur 100 Mbit), Step-down 5-17 V auf 5 V, Umschalter gegen Rückstrom. Zitat: "it does not have a PoE capability", "NEXX ITSELF HAS 1.2 ADC". "The 5 VDC are short-circuited on both microUSB and USB-A ports"
openwrt_wiki.Flash-Vergrößerung: Anleitung zum Tausch des SO8-SPI-Flash gegen 16/32 MB (MX25L128/MX25L256), danach eigener Build nötig; U-Boot-TFTP Option 2, Server 192.168.0.233, Datei root_uImage
